BAE Systems develops advanced defense, aerospace, and security technologies for military and national security applications. The Software Engineer I will support the development of embedded software for systems including Signals Intelligence, Aircraft Protection, Radar Warning, and Electronic Attack by analyzing, designing, coding, modifying, integrating, and testing software in Windows and Linux environments.
Defense & Space
No H1B
U.S. Citizen Only
Responsibilities
Duties include analyzing, designing, coding and code modification (typically in C++) of complex software designs for simple systems or subsystems or subsystems of larger systems
You will be assisting in the evaluation of complex software designs to identify design flaws
You will utilize either a Windows or Linux based software development environment
You will be integrating and testing in the selected target test environments
